explication: WatchYourLAN scans local network interfaces, reconciles discovered hosts into current and historical state, and presents results through a web UI/API. The main workflow is browser request or scheduled scan → API or scanner orchestration → host/history state → UI or optional notifications/metrics exports. The graph also includes configuration, retention, network actions, and documented integrations. Several handler implementations and frontend API helpers were not sampled, so uncertain storage-call edges are omitted.
